description: Department of Trade & Investment Policy - Notify the Special Commodity Levy on Maize, w.e.f. 09.08.2018
categorisation: This gazette content is an order issued under the Special Commodity Levy Act, No. 48 of 2007, imposing specific levy rates on commodities. It constitutes a regulatory instrument that modifies or implements existing legislation, falling squarely under Legal/Regulatory matters (Type 5). While it mentions a minister's name and title, the primary purpose is regulatory implementation rather than detailing the minister's portfolio responsibilities or making a personnel announcement.
